apps.title: SOTA (Android)
apps.description: A watch-based app that tracks time between points, timeouts, and halftime.  Android only.

apps.title: UltiObserver (Android)
apps.description: A phone-based app that tracks time and game state, intended to replace both paper scoresheets and a stopwatch.  Android only.

books.title: The Social Ref
books.description: This book dives deeply into the 'soft skills' necessary to be a game official: communication, game management, conflict resolution, etc.  It's an excellent read.

jerseys.title: Official USAU orange jersey
jerseys.description: The official orange jersey of the observer program.  You absolutely must have one of these.

jerseys.title: Official USAU green jersey
jerseys.description: The official green jersey of the observer program.  It's highly recommended to have one of these.

jerseys.title: Long-sleeve orange jersey
jerseys.description: An unofficial long-sleeved variant of the orange jersey. May be useful in cold conditions, though some people find that it complicates wearing a radio.

observerManuals.title: USAU observer manual (PDF)
observerManuals.description: The official USAU observer manual, discussing how to apply the rules and how to conduct yourself as an observer.  Last updated April 2024.

observerUniversityVideos.title: Volume 1
observerUniversityVideos.description: Created for return-to-play in 2021, the first installment of this educational video series walks through many topics at a shallow level. ~75 minutes.

observerUniversityVideos.title: Volume 2
observerUniversityVideos.description: The second installment gets more tactical, diving deeper into what actually occurs on the field throughout a game. ~75 minutes.

observerUniversityVideos.title: Volume 3
observerUniversityVideos.description: The final installment discusses the harder aspects of game management, and includes several videos as examples. ~75 minutes.

radios.title: Ejeas V4
radios.description: The de-facto standard for radio communication. Allows pairing up to 4 headsets. Many observers have a pair of these.

radios.title: Ejeas V6
radios.description: Similar to the V4's, with the major drawback of only being able to pair two headsets. Seems to be slightly more reliable and have higher-quality audio.

rules.title: USAU rules (web)
rules.description: The web-based version of USAU's 2026-2027 official rules.

rules.title: USAU rules (PDF)
rules.description: The PDF version of USAU's 2026-2027 official rules; well-suited for printing.

rules.title: Dynamic rules
rules.description: A more user-friendly web version of the rules.  Allows pinning different rules to see them side-by-side, and easy sharing of those views. Also contains WUL, PUL, and UFA rules.

rulesQuizzes.title: USAU college rules quiz
rulesQuizzes.description: This was sent to teams prior to 2026 College Nationals.  It's relatively short and simple.

rulesQuizzes.title: Cotton's rules quiz
rulesQuizzes.description: A longer, more difficult, and more comprehensive quiz.  This occasionally makes the rounds among teams, and has over 4,000 responses to date.

scorecards.title: Official USAU scorecard
scorecards.description: The scorecard contained in the observer manual; technically the 'official' observer scorecard.

scorecards.title: Horizontal 1
scorecards.description: A horizontally-oriented scorecard, with slots to track ABBA gender-matching.

scorecards.title: Horizontal 2
scorecards.description: Another horizontally-oriented scorecard, with larger score boxes; also has ABBA tracking slots.

scorecards.title: Vertical 1
scorecards.description: A vertically-oriented scorecard, also with ABBA tracking slots.

scorecards.title: Vertical 2
scorecards.description: Another vertical scorecard, with shading to help differentiate light/dark and ABBA tracking at a glance.

shoes.title: Salomon SpeedCross
shoes.description: For those who prefer trail-runners over cleats, these seem to be the de-facto standard.  They're black, and come in men's, women's, wide, and Gore-Tex.
